hypotheses.name: Certified Cognitive Continuity
hypotheses.hypothesis: At matched model, visible facts and token budget, a truthful event-driven latent memory field feeding bounded Assemblies improves next-action quality over explicit-retrieval-only, while relation/temporal shuffled fields do not.
hypotheses.counter: Any gain is only extra information/order/retrieval compute, not between-call continuity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched factorial shows truthful field no better than OFF/shuffled after equalizing candidate facts/order/tokens/compute.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: FIELD {OFF,truthful,relation-shuffled,temporal-shuffled} x MEMORY_PATH {explicit-only,continuity} with fixed WorkspaceEpisode/projection and target 4B.

hypotheses.name: Integrity asymmetry
hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic ancestry/epoch/firebreak validation can eliminate stale/revoked activation influence but cannot generally detect semantically misleading yet individually authentic role-shuffled associations.
hypotheses.counter: Sufficient provenance and selector receipts alone guarantee cognitive relevance.
hypotheses.falsifier: A deterministic integrity-only checker detects role-shuffled authentic relevance errors without access to query/task semantics or an external oracle.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Adversarial activation suite separating stale/revoked, relation-role-shuffled, temporal-shuffled and authentic-but-irrelevant candidates.

hypotheses.name: Collection semantics are causal identity
hypotheses.hypothesis: SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED/PRIORITY semantics must survive ClayCode->UnifiedDB lowering and be bound in query/selection-plan identity, because type erasure can change candidate multiplicity/order and downstream GWT behavior without changing record authenticity.
hypotheses.counter: Collection kind is merely serialization detail and can be inferred/reconstructed downstream.
hypotheses.falsifier: Cross-engine lowering with erased collection type preserves all query results, candidate hashes and downstream selections across adversarial duplicate/order/weight cases.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Property-based differential lowering across SQLite/Postgres/graph/vector adapters with candidate-set and WorkspaceEpisode receipt comparison.

hypotheses.name: Canonical re-entry before persistent memory mutation
hypotheses.hypothesis: Persistent outcome/self/goal updates should first become an authoritative canonical event/receipt; graph/vector/FTS/activation updates should derive from that event rather than accepting direct model/workspace writes.
hypotheses.counter: Direct workspace/model mutation of persistent activation is safe if local confidence is high.
hypotheses.falsifier: Direct-mutation path matches canonical-event-first path under crash/replay/revocation/adversarial re-entry with no provenance or recovery deficit and lower cost.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Crash/replay/revocation differential with direct activation mutation vs canonical append+derivation log.

hypotheses.name: Multi-clock causal replay
hypotheses.hypothesis: Replayable cognition requires distinct witnesses for canonical commit identity, semantic/graph epoch, activation epoch, selection/query-plan identity, WorkspaceEpisode and reader-view identity rather than one global version.
hypotheses.counter: One global monotonically increasing snapshot/version is simpler and sufficient at acceptable cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: Global-version design achieves equal causal replay and effect safety with no material false invalidation/contention penalty in target traces.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Trace-driven global-barrier vs operation-scoped witness replay benchmark.

hypotheses.name: Adaptive physical placement
hypotheses.hypothesis: The optimal physical boundary is workload/subplan/device dependent; stable Clay semantics plus cost/risk placement outperforms any universal monolith or universal microservice layout across latency, recovery and authority risk.
hypotheses.counter: A single-process/one-store monolith dominates once implementation overhead is optimized.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target Linux+Android traces show one fixed placement Pareto-dominates hybrid/adaptive placement across latency, RAM, energy, crash recovery and authority isolation.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Trace-driven placement sweep with same semantic receipts across monolith/services/hybrid.

hypotheses.name: Continuity x reader-rail interaction
hypotheses.hypothesis: The benefit of latent memory continuity for a small 4B depends on MRSC/COVE reader projection; operation-compiled views may convert latent associative state into useful reasoning more efficiently than raw/global state.
hypotheses.counter: Memory-field benefit is independent of reader representation.
hypotheses.falsifier: No FIELD x RAIL interaction under matched information and token budget across target 4B tasks.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: FIELD {OFF,truthful,shuffled} x RAIL {raw,COVE/P1,P2-native} factorial on target 4B.

hypotheses.name: Semantic unity needs authority compartmentalization
hypotheses.hypothesis: Full Clay semantic unification can reduce translation cost only if capability/effect authority remains structurally isolated and no semantic class or latent/activation state can implicitly amplify authority.
hypotheses.counter: Typed Clay semantics inside one runtime make a separate capability broker unnecessary.
hypotheses.falsifier: Adversarial confused-deputy/data-injection suite shows same-domain typed runtime equal or safer than isolated broker with equivalent availability/cost.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Runtime-enforced cast/capability attack matrix with broker ON/OFF and identical model outputs.

hypotheses.name: Continuity is not emergence
hypotheses.hypothesis: Persistent latent activation, recurrent GWT use and self-state continuity can improve function without satisfying E-CERT2 Axis A+B; emergence claims require independent stage-orthogonal lesion/rescue/OOD/multiscale evidence.
hypotheses.counter: Stable self-referential recurrent continuity is sufficient evidence of an emergent organ.
hypotheses.falsifier: A preregistered candidate passes full E-CERT2 with continuity as the isolated necessary mechanism and independent replication.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Prospective SELF/continuity candidate with role-aware recurrence, lesion, mechanistic rescue, future re-entry, OOD and multiscale controls.

hypotheses.name: Zero-copy is subordinate to semantics
hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared/zero-copy buffers improve hot-path cost only when exact type/schema/identity/lifetime receipts survive; raw pointer sharing without semantic/epoch/view identity creates faster but less auditable failure modes.
hypotheses.counter: ABI/schema identity alone is enough; semantic receipts are unnecessary overhead.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fault/fuzz tests show raw zero-copy route retains equivalent semantic, selection and replay guarantees without explicit receipts.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Rust/Arrow/shared-memory differential fuzz with schema, epoch, role and projection mutations.

hypotheses.name: Full-model Clay adaptation increases common-mode semantic risk
hypotheses.hypothesis: As Qwen internalizes Clay and translation boundaries disappear, errors in Clay compiler/type/query semantics become more correlated across memory, workspace and model reasoning, so semantic firebreak/receipt coverage becomes more—not less—important.
hypotheses.counter: Full native adaptation reduces enough representation error that common-mode risk decreases monotonically.
hypotheses.falsifier: Full-FT checkpoints show lower cross-stage correlated semantic failure than mixed/external representations under matched adversarial suites without additional firebreaks.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Checkpoint progression with shared semantic mutation suite across memory/query/GWT/model/effect stages.

hypotheses.name: Dual-path memory
hypotheses.hypothesis: A bounded latent continuity path plus explicit exact/graph/vector/FTS fallback dominates either always-search or activation-only memory under matched cost by combining automatic availability with deliberate verification/broad search.
hypotheses.counter: One memory mode can be tuned to dominate and the dual path only adds complexity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Trace-driven target tasks show always-search or activation-only Pareto-dominates dual-path on accuracy, false association, latency, tokens and energy.
hypotheses.highest_information_test: Three-arm memory policy benchmark with equal model and information access.
